Issue.title: Want to create a new policy
Issue.description: The agency representative is attempting to create a new policy via the CCC Agency Portal.

Issue.title: Cannot access the CCC Agency Portal
Issue.description: The agency representative receives a 'Server not found' error when trying to open the CCC Agency Portal; it worked yesterday, the account is active, and servers are normal. The office VPN software was updated this morning.

Solution.title: Contact internal IT to whitelist the CCC Agency Portal URL
Solution.description: Reach out to DDD Agency's IT support to whitelist the CCC Agency Portal URL or adjust VPN/firewall settings that may be blocking access. The insurer cannot change these corporate network settings.
